title: Masters of the Universe
plot_overview: After years apart, a powerful sword guides a young prince back to a shattered Eternia, now under a fearsome ruler’s control. To protect his family and save his world, he must unite with trusted allies and accept the heroic destiny waiting within him.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you like colorful, self-aware fantasy adventures such as Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings; Not for you if you want a serious, tightly paced epic.
review_summary: Pros: colorful fantasy world; charismatic performances; energetic action | Cons: overlong pacing; uneven humor; thin supporting roles
